notes: Ships everything it uses: the module experts (Probation, TND, Recruitment, any-repo router), the self-review agents and the Probation + TND maps.
Ships phr-autotester, hrm-test-autorunner and flowchart-house-style, so Dev testing and diagrams work on any machine.
The procedures now carry their own settings (wiki pages, skip lists, palette) — 0.9.0 left them out.
SQL standards are invoked, not remembered: the table/column checker must pass before the SQL gate; the exception framework is asked once per release line.
The Bug Fixer's engineering rules in both procedures: dep.xml, labels and localisations, byte-precise edits, the build harness, sandbox and database rules.
No Update-skill button: a newer skill replaces yours automatically and keeps your own settings.
